corrections: Delta 9.7 is structural, not rare. The earlier framing ('at 21 chargers that is unlikely') understates it: every connector on a vendor-native Zaptec-authentication installation produces neither session nor StatusNotification evidence, permanently and by construction. Verified by grep - the Zaptec importer writes connector_id null, and StatusNotification only reaches events.event_log from our own OCPP gateway.

Two static gates would have gone blind to this round's code without conforming to their textual matching: gen-api-endpoints.mjs (nine endpoints invisible) and check-orgid-param.mjs (nine tenancy gates invisible). Both were conformed to rather than worked around, and the coupling is documented at each declaration.

My own: the first route-test helper had an unused leading `path` parameter, so every call passed its intended idempotency key as the path and fell back to one shared default key - which made the drive-through calls replay each other and eighteen assertions fail for one reason.
